name: Trio of Veal: Grilled Tenderloin, Pulled Shank & Tortellacci Pasta (Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Magic · Rapunzel's Royal Table (Snuggly Duckling Night 2)
whyItWorks: Fine-grained veal tenderloin, fork-tender braised veal shank, and soft egg pasta tortellacci have minimal connective tissue and low fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the demi-glace sauce on the side and take a Lactaid for the cheese inside the tortellacci.
